import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

f2 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0002.png').convert('RGB'))
f4 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0004.png').convert('RGB'))

# Find chair pixels (brown)
chair_mask2 = (f2[:, :, 0] > 90) & (f2[:, :, 0] < 160) & (f2[:, :, 1] > 40) & (f2[:, :, 1] < 90) & (f2[:, :, 2] < 50)

print('F2 chair pixels:', np.sum(chair_mask2))
